long_biography.plain_text:
In the 2006 Geneva Polo Masters, Yasmine Firmenich Luginbühl played on the Veytay side that successfully defended its title. Competing alongside her stepsons Simon and Martin Luginbühl and the Argentine professional Horacio Fernandez Llorente, she helped win a closely contested final. Polo also became an organisational responsibility: she has run the Veytay club with her husband.

Trained as a lawyer, she has taken board roles as well as sporting ones. She represented Anaïs Ventures when it invested in the Swiss SailGP team in 2025, explaining the family's commitment to sailing and to developing Swiss talent. The investment supported the team's recruitment and technical development.

In the 2006 Geneva Polo Masters, Yasmine Firmenich Luginbühl played on the Veytay side that successfully defended its title. Polo also became an organisational responsibility: she has run the Veytay club with her husband.

Trained as a lawyer, she has taken board roles as well as sporting ones. She represented Anaïs Ventures when it invested in the Swiss SailGP team in 2025, explaining the family's commitment to sailing and to developing Swiss talent. The investment supported the team's recruitment and technical development.
